lines.t: 1 The Lord says to his servant, My son, when you have truly made your decision, I myself shall finish it.
Look not to tomorrow
For today is the day
Today is when you must decide
Even this very moment
It is time to overcome
Indeed you must be willing
To give up your life for my sake
Or how shall I send you?
For as it is written
Those who do not take up their cross
And follow me
Are not fit to be
My disciples
For they have shown themselves unworthy of me
And how shall one who loves his father or mother
Or son or daughter more than me escape?
For they too have shown themselves unworthy of me
Thus many are called, yet few are chosen
Yet understand this, as I have spoken it
So shall it be
For there is a day coming when I shall come upon my chosen
And overshadow my elect
A day when all my faithful ones shall fly away
The day my beloved are made new
And in that day the prophet's reward shall be yours also
If you too remain faithful
Therefore gird up your loins
And become the man of God you aspire to be
Stand firm for my cause and do not waver
Draw very close and receive of me
For indeed my grace is sufficient
For all those who trust in me
Says the Lord
